tasks.description: Optimize frontend code to reduce load times and improve responsiveness. Focus on reducing unnecessary HTTP requests and minifying CSS/JS files. This task should be completed by a frontend engineer.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user navigates to the homepage, when the page loads, then the load time is less than 2 seconds

tasks.description: Implement caching for frequently accessed data to reduce database queries and improve response times. This task should be completed by a backend engineer.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests data, when the data is cached, then the response time is less than 500ms

tasks.description: Migrate the database to a faster and more efficient solution to improve query performance. This task should be completed by a database engineer.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user runs a query, when the query is executed, then the execution time is less than 1 second

tasks.description: Create a dashboard to track and monitor performance metrics such as load times, response times, and error rates. This task should be completed by a DevOps engineer.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user navigates to the dashboard, when the dashboard loads, then the user can view performance metrics

tasks.description: Write scripts to test and measure the performance of the application under various loads and scenarios. This task should be completed by a QA engineer.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user runs a performance test, when the test completes, then the test results are accurate and reliable

tasks.description: Identify and optimize slow database queries to improve performance. This task should be completed by a database engineer.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user runs a query, when the query is executed, then the execution time is less than 500ms

tasks.description: Implement a CDN to reduce the distance between users and the application, improving load times and responsiveness. This task should be completed by a DevOps engineer.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user navigates to the application, when the application loads, then the load time is less than 1 second

tasks.description: Create a report to track and measure the performance improvements made during the quarter. This task should be completed by a project manager.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user views the report, when the report is generated, then the report accurately reflects performance improvements
